stem.text: A butane burner is used to heat water. The $M_\text{r}$ of butane is 58.

items: $250\,\text{g}$ of water is heated from $12\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ to $100\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
The burner transfers 47% of the heat released from the burning fuel to the water.

stem.text: Assume that the butane undergoes complete combustion and none of the water evaporates.
What is the minimum mass of butane that must be burnt?
